title: Quick Italian Green Beans Stracciatella
description: A resinous and snappy Italian dish featuring caramelized green beans in a low-fat friendly stracciatella form, served in a hot pot vessel. This Tuscan-inspired recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large hot pot vessel over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the green beans and cook for 5 minutes until they start to caramelize.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes until the green beans are tender.
Stir in the grated parmesan cheese until melted and well combined.
Create wells in the green bean mixture and crack in the eggs.
Cover the vessel and cook for an additional 5 minutes until the eggs are cooked to desired doneness.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the stracciatella hot, garnished with additional parmesan cheese if desired.
